question: How will the text respond to the substantialist view of impurity and initiation?
premises: The substantialist view is criticized by reasoning and scripture.
The text promises to refute that view later.
The text will also explain the status of impurity, maya, and karma.
inference: The author postpones a fuller refutation and will clarify the true status of impurity, maya, and karma.
plain_english: We will refute that view later, since it is condemned by reasoning and scripture, and we will show the true status of impurity, maya, and karma.
